identity: An AFP-style Arabic news-wire report on Hadi al-Bahra's election as president of the Syrian opposition coalition: headline, lede, then attributed paragraphs of fact, quotation and two candidate mini-biographies. Register = §Q news wire.
law: News wire is a SHORT-unit register, ~7-15 tokens per sentence (LAW 0-quad). Every <NL> is a free boundary. Inside a paragraph I cut at every fresh finite predication after a complete statement: و + finite verb (وأمضى, وكان), an asyndetic finite verb (سعى, غادر, خرج). I weld the protected sites: speech verb + its quote, the participial adjunct مشيرا (not finite), relative clauses (الذي شارفت, التي حصلت), locative حيث hanging off the preceding NP (في السعودية حيث تسلم), the attribution tail بحسب ما ذكر, purpose clauses (ليخلف, ليعيش ويتولى), و joining nouns (وتدخلات, ومؤسسات), and the subordinating contrastive بينما.
reasoning: @74 صوتا: سعى الثلاثاء has no connective and no plausible subject in the preceding clause (a losing rival would not be seeking a consensus formula) - it is the coalition, so this is an asyndetic new sentence, the same shape as doc_a4029b2c8e1b's لم يتم التوصل. CUT. @63 I did NOT cut before مشيرا: it is a circumstantial participle, not a finite verb, so the protected list holds even though it makes a 26-token segment. @142 جديدة is my weakest call: وهناك مسعى is a fresh existential predication but هناك is not a verb, and it may sit under a comma inside the reported speech; I cut because a 38-token news paragraph is implausible and my standing error is under-cutting - marked lo. @175: بينما خالد خوجة محسوب is a nominal subordinate contrastive with no finite verb, so it welds despite the 26-token length; the paragraph also looks garbled around محسوب and I have no confident internal site. @182 إجمالا then @209 1959: both وكان/وأمضى are و + finite verb with new complements - the exact shape I missed repeatedly in doc_a74a9e93d97a (وكان قد شرع, وبدأ حياته) - hi. @199 ولم تؤد welds because it is coordinated inside the relative clause التي حصلت, same subject, no new predication of its own. @244 المعارض: وكان لا يزال فتى صغيرا could be read as a haal circumstantial (weld) but it is و + finite verb with a new predicate; med. @256 عشرة: وانتقل shares the subject with خرج but brings a new complement إلى تركيا, which is the doc_a045e64631c7 وكبرت المولودة / وأصبحت طفلة pattern rather than the يحبونها ويقدرونها gapping pattern; lo. @264 ويتولى welds - it is a second subjunctive coordinated under ليعيش. Final check: 17 boundaries over 261 real tokens = 15.4 tokens/segment, inside the news band.
